review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: In today's society, news media play an increasingly important role in people's daily lives. With the development of technology, people can access news more easily than ever before.

Admittedly, I believe that news media bring several negative impacts. One major reason is that people are constantly exposed to news through smartphones and the Internet. These technologies allow people to follow the news instantly no matter where they are or What time is it, making news consumption become a regular part of their routine. Furthermore, there is intense competition among news outlets to gain people's attention. As a result, media agencies often focus on shocking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner. Dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals are also be used to attract readers. Consequently, people will become more concerned and from that increase the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, it is important for we to understand about the benefits that news bring. Constant exposure to a stream of distressing and exaggerated news such as crime or political corruption may make people feel overly anxious or helpless, even when that do not directly affect them. Nevertheless, news coverage can warn the public to existing and looming problems in society. With people being informed, they will be more prepared to respond to potential threats and handle ricks in a complex society. For example, information about natural disaster can encourage ppl to take safety actions before it occurs.

In conclusion, I am convinced that news media may negatively affect people's lives, mainly because of the widespread use of technology items and the sensational presence of news. However, I believe that news can inform the public and raise awareness about existing concernings.

completion.comment: Cô đã đối chiếu đủ trang gốc: bài có mở bài, hai đoạn thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em có đủ nội dung, chuyển nhánh khá rõ và ví dụ thiên tai phục vụ đúng vai trò cảnh báo. Điểm cần sửa trước hết là lập trường mở bài và phạm vi hai câu chủ đề: thân bài đang làm đúng nhiều việc nhưng nhãn chủ đề chưa khớp. Sau đó em phải rà lỗi đảo câu hỏi, thừa be, for we và viết tắt ppl. Cô giữ nguyên phần With people being informed vì cấu trúc đó dùng được.

Admittedly, I believe that news media have a considerable influence on people's lives. One major reason is that people are constantly exposed to news through smartphones and the Internet. These technologies allow people to follow the news instantly no matter where they are or what time it is, making news consumption become a regular part of their routine. Dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals are also used to attract readers. Consequently, people will become more concerned, thereby increasing the overall impact of news on public opinion.

As for these effects, it is important for us to understand that news can cause distress while also bringing benefits. Nevertheless, news coverage can warn the public to existing and looming problems in society. With people being informed, they will be more prepared to respond to potential threats and handle risks in a complex society. For example, information about a natural disaster can encourage people to take protective action before it occurs.

In conclusion, I am convinced that news media have a substantial influence on people's lives, mainly due to the widespread use of technology and the sensational presentation of news. Although this can cause distress, I believe that news can inform the public and raise awareness about existing concerns.
